parameters.content:
## Setup
1. Set these environment variables on the n8n instance: `ROUTEWISE_URL` (for example https://your-app.example), `ROUTEWISE_SECRET` (the source's signing secret), optional `ROUTEWISE_SOURCE` (default `website`).
2. n8n 2.x blocks `$env` access in nodes by default: set `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`, or replace `$env.*` with n8n Variables or a credential.
3. Point your form at this workflow's production webhook URL.

The HTTP node retries 3 times (2 s apart). Retries are safe because every payload carries an `external_id`.
